description: Four new shell fixtures omit the SPDX headers required for new .sh files by CLAUDE.md.
The cache-bound rationale says six parsed sources moved the population from 65 to 71, but the census scans only shell files and the exact change is four sources, 68 to 72.
The release note says any shipped sentence naming the paths was flagged, although valid pruned-path-ok markers already exempted marked lines.
The release note calls both observability flags new, but --print-prune-set existed at the base SHA.
The parser docstring calls every path-shaped docs default a doc root even though release_notes_file is a file path.
The durable PR/workpad surface has no complete Writing-skills evidence record for this prompt-surface change.
Supplying both print flags exits successfully with undocumented exempt-first precedence, and no test pins or rejects the combination.
The equality-not-prefix test covers a finer default against a coarser target but not the reverse prefix direction.
The whole-population assertion proves only a positive audited count rather than equality with an independent tracked-file count.
